name: custom-closes-chunk-stream-fatal
description: CUSTOM ends an open chunk stream, so the id-less continuation that follows has no referent and is fatal
kill: move CUSTOM onto the list of events that stand aside from chunk assembly, alongside RAW

expect.errorContains: First TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK must have a messageId

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. With no chunk stage the CUSTOM event closes nothing and the following id-less chunk raises no violation, so the stream is accepted instead of rejected.
